threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [S] F5 kills full rendered mode harder than the parked B5 decision did: glamour v2 STILL has no source mapping, and nobody else solved it either. If you want rendered markdown someday, the honest path is building our own goldmark-based renderer with a line map — a big standalone project, not a TUI polish item. Worth an explicit non-goal in the plan.
